public_title: R18 stopped on an inference-model reference conflict; partial work is preserved
public_summary: The selected inference model failed an identity check during current-model processing. No new target estimator was committed. Two scalar calibrations, verified reuse, source refresh and the expanded population ledger were preserved in an intact return. Twelve cores were admitted, but average use was about 0.56 core; the real-science utilization acceptance gate did not run. This is a completed failed execution, not a claim about any currently running process. An independent immutable-write audit also verifies 20 forecast rows issued before deadline for one women’s game; these have no completed outcome and are separate from historical performance.

count_scope: New targets, new calibrations and reused targets are separate categories. Reuse counts are not new training and are not added into a count of unique models. The recent-run tally covers only R16, R17 and R18. The new issued rows comprise eight winner, six margin and six total predictions for one event, not 20 games or complete upcoming coverage.
public_limitations: The complete official season denominator, historical time qualification, full-population champion comparison and source-matched provider comparison remain unresolved. R19 repair is prepared; AWS execution is pending. Publication adds no forecasts, fits or model promotions.
